title: PROVERBS 4:18
THE SHINING PATH
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: foggy forest path early morning dawn light
golden dawn light breaking over misty mountain path
bright sunrise over scenic valley horizon
soft morning sunlight through mountain trees
calm lake reflecting vibrant golden sunrise
peaceful dawn horizon over quiet countryside
soft morning sunlight streaming through window

scenes.a: If you woke early with doubt overshadowing your next steps, hear what Scripture promises you.
But the path of the just is as the shining light,
that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
Lord, when the way ahead feels dim or uncertain, remind us that Your truth grows brighter with every step of faith.
You do not leave us wandering in dark shadows, but clear our vision until Your fullness shines.
Walk before us this day, ordering our decisions and steadying our hearts in Your peace.
Subscribe to The Morning Altar to start each sunrise praying together.
